question: Where is museum situated within 110 kilometers along the travel path toward Sonesta ES Suites Malvern, Malvern, PA from South 6th St. Community Garden, Philadelphia, PA?
sql: SELECT id, poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois WHERE museum IS NOT NULL AND ST_Intersects( geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%South 6th St. Community Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Philadelphia%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sonesta ES Suites Malvern%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Malvern%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 110000 -- 110 kilometers in meters ) );
